title: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026
summary: Banking Associate and Probationary Officer. Advertisement numbers JKB/HR/Rectt/2026-493 and 494.
facts: Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university
20 to 30 years, relaxation for SC, ST, OBC and PwBD as per rules
Rs. 600 for SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD/ESM, Rs. 800 for all others
Banking Associate Rs. 24,050, Probationary Officer Rs. 48,480, plus allowances
faqs: How many vacancies are there?

Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd. has announced 1053 vacancies for Banking Associates and Probationary Officers under advertisement numbers JKB/HR/Rectt/2026-493 and 494. Candidates apply online on the official website.
Which posts are available?
Banking Associate has 1033 vacancies and Probationary Officer has 20 vacancies. Both need a graduate degree from a recognized university and the required domicile certificate.
What are the start and last dates?
Online applications open on 7 November 2026 and close on 26 November 2026. Apply early to avoid website slowdowns near the closing date.
What is the minimum qualification?
A graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university, for both posts. Domicile documents are also mandatory.
What is the age limit?
Minimum 20 years and maximum 30 years. Upper age relaxation applies to reserved categories such as SC, ST, OBC and PwBD as per the guidelines.
What is the selection process?
Banking Associates go through an online examination followed by document verification. Probationary Officers have an additional interview after the online examination and document check.
What is the application fee?
For Banking Associates the fee is Rs. 600 for SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD/ESM candidates and Rs. 800 for all other categories, paid online.
Can candidates from other states apply?
No. Only domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and the Union Territory of Ladakh are eligible, as per the special conditions in the official notification.
What salary can selected candidates expect?
Banking Associates receive a basic pay of Rs. 24,050 in a structured scale. Probationary Officers start with a basic pay of Rs. 48,480 in their scale, with applicable allowances.
How do I apply?

Visit jkb.bank.in, open the careers section, register, fill in the online application form, upload the required documents and pay the fee online. Gupta Cyber Cafe can do this for you. Send a WhatsApp message to 9086703813.
applyNote: Apply at Gupta Cyber Cafe. WhatsApp: 9086703813

title: JKSSB MTS / Class-IV Recruitment 2026
summary: Advertisement No. 09 of 2026. Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) and Sanitation Worker posts in UT, divisional and district cadres.
facts: 2863 total: UT Cadre 105, Divisional Cadre 1990, District Cadre 768
MTS: Matriculation to 10+2. Sanitation Worker: 8th Pass to 10+2
As on 01.01.2026: 40 years (Open Merit), 43 years (reserved and other eligible categories), 42 years (PwBD)
Rs. 600 (General, OM, OBC, RBA, ALC/IB). Rs. 500 (SC, ST-1, ST-2, EWS, PwBD). Online payment only
Pay level SL1: Rs. 14,800 to Rs. 47,100
Objective written test with negative marking and additional weightage, then document verification
Mandatory: Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir
faqs: How many vacancies are there?
2863 posts in total: 105 UT Cadre, 1990 Divisional Cadre (Jammu and Kashmir) and 768 District Cadre across 20 districts. The number may change during selection.
Which posts are available?
Class-IV (MTS) and Sanitation Worker posts under Advertisement No. 09 of 2026.
What is the last date to apply?
27 November 2026, 11:59 PM. It was extended from 12 November 2026. Apply well before the last date to avoid portal congestion.
What is the qualification?
For MTS, matriculation (10th) minimum and 10+2 maximum. For Sanitation Worker, 8th pass minimum and 10+2 maximum. Candidates must hold a valid J&K domicile certificate.
What is the age limit?

Age is counted as on 01.01.2026. Maximum 40 years for Open Merit, 43 years for reserved and other eligible categories, and 42 years for PwBD. Relaxations for ex-servicemen and casual workers apply as per the notification.
What is the application fee?
Rs. 600 for General, OM, OBC, RBA and ALC/IB candidates. Rs. 500 for SC, ST-1, ST-2, EWS and PwBD candidates. The fee is payable online only and is non-refundable.
How is selection done?
An objective written test with negative marking, plus additional weightage marks based on cadre, followed by document verification.
What salary is offered?
Pay level SL1, pay scale Rs. 14,800 to Rs. 47,100.
How do I apply?
Apply online at jkssb.nic.in. Gupta Cyber Cafe can fill the form, upload your photo and signature and pay the fee for you. Message 9086703813 on WhatsApp.
applyNote: Apply at Gupta Cyber Cafe. WhatsApp: 9086703813 or 8825096033
